connector.name: Kolada MCP Server

connector.summary: Hosted at kolada-mcp-pafn.onrender.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package kolada-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the isakskogstad account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
